positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•Part of a team creating a cell tower emulation platform used for phone modem testing.
•Worked on modem software, implementing new, UMTS related features, such as enabling phones to transfer service from one cell tower emulator to another without losing connection during a call.
•Restructured the modem validation test code to utilize a new, more capable FPGA device for testing.
•Resolved several high priority, customer visible bugs, requiring fast, effective solutions.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•	Resolved several bugs and implemented new features, such as sending logging information to a remote server using the Syslog protocol and executing debug commands on a remote system.
•	Gained experience in sockets programming, inter-process communication in distributed systems,      and software engineering practices.
